entities.summary: Arshak Jamalyan sometimes Arshag Djamalian was an Armenian politician. He was a prominent Dashnak member who took part in the Armenian-Azeri conflicts. Jamalian was also the Minister of Communications to Tiflis. who served as Minister of Communication of the First Republic of Armenia in 1920.
